- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/members` — The tenant's members, then those invited and not yet in
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/invitations` — Invite somebody by email, with a role (admins only)
- `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/members/{user_id}` — Change a member's role (admins only)
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/members/{user_id}` — Remove a member (admins), or leave (anyone, naming themselves)
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/invitations/{invitation_id}` — Take an invitation back before it is accepted (admins only)

## Invite somebody by email, with a role (admins only)

`POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/invitations` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [InvitationIn](/reference/api/schemas/#invitationin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `email` | string (email) |  |
| `role` | `admin`, `member` |  |
| `locale` *(optional)* | `en`, `es` | default `"en"` |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | [MemberOut](/reference/api/schemas/#memberout) |
| 403 | [`not_admin`](/reference/errors/#not_admin) |
| 409 | [`already_member`](/reference/errors/#already_member) |
| 422 | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/schemas/#httpvalidationerror) — Validation Error |
| 503 | [`mail_unavailable`](/reference/errors/#mail_unavailable) |

## Remove a member (admins), or leave (anyone, naming themselves)

| Status | Answer |
